title: 彭博李庭：7亿美元AI硬件融资，香港IPO市场重燃
speaker: Lienting To

segments.en: Yeah, I think it does signal that there is still a lot of investor appetite to back the AI hardware story despite the huge volatility that we're seeing in all the chip stocks.
segments.zh: 我认为这确实表明，尽管芯片股波动巨大，但投资者仍对AI硬件故事有浓厚兴趣。

segments.en: So as you mentioned, in the light, $7 billion. And that could be the biggest since Alibaba's 2019 secondary listing. And if it exercises its over allotment, and that would be $8 billion.
segments.zh: 正如你提到的，70亿美元。这可能是自阿里巴巴2019年二次上市以来最大的一笔。如果行使超额配股权，将达到80亿美元。

segments.en: And you know, John Dino also got about $3.45 billion from cornerstone commitments already. And that includes long-term investors, such as BlackRock, Tamsak Hill House.
segments.zh: 而且，John Dino已从基石投资者获得约34.5亿美元承诺，包括贝莱德、淡马锡等长期投资者。

segments.en: What that means is that those long-term investors are still quite confident in the AI demand for those hardware names. So that definitely sends a very strong signal.
segments.zh: 这意味着长期投资者对AI硬件需求依然相当有信心，这无疑发出了非常强烈的信号。
